notes: S2-FIX4 F83/F84 (decision 2026-11-16 #4; §5.3, §11.5, §14.9): container/previous-key-not-trusted-in-target with the owner declaration's body removed (the F84 mutant 151115/941868555482201572; E_ENV_MISSING_FIELD). The owner key then has no material, so the owner cosignature on the device declaration is unverified (E_KEY_UNKNOWN) and that declaration supplies no material (§5.3): the supplied previous's signature by the device key is not by a required key of the target context (E_MANIFEST_CHAIN), and since no context material verified any equation the report carries no L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU.
